about: The raw markup sinks block code and the AI chat may have (#14 slice 2, the rendering boundary; #21 for the chat): each file and function with its count and kind, and the issue that removes it. Block code puts rich text into the DOM only through the trusted-rendering port (js/kernel/core/ports/rendering.js), whose legacy adapter's render is its one dynamic sink besides packaged icons. The AI chat renders every reply through AIChatController.replyHtml, which shows a reply's plain text as text before its Markdown is read (Utils.parseMarkdown) and runs sanitizeHtml after; its other sinks are packaged markup. test/render-sinks.test.js scans the files and directories in scope and fails on a sink no row covers, a count that changed, or a row whose sink is gone. A static sink assigns a string or a template with no substitutions, or such text joined with +; assigning the empty string isn't a sink.
